notes: Top SQL #1 (products-by-category SELECT) dominates db_load at 6.4 AAS — that is ~77% of total load. Per-call duration is fast (18 ms) but call rate climbed from a baseline of ~16/sec to 82/sec over the window. The load is volume, not cost.
Top SQL #2 (payment_events INSERT) is the normal write path; its call rate is normal.

Top SQL #3 (customer-by-id SELECT) is the typical session-lookup pattern, slightly elevated alongside the product-list calls, consistent with each user session making one customer-lookup plus one or more product-list requests.
Top SQL #4 (materialized view refresh) is a scheduled background task; its db_load is unchanged from baseline.

Top hosts: the four 10.0.1.x IPs map to the prod-api-asg instances (i-0a11..i-0a44) and account for ~93% of total db_load. The two 10.0.2.x IPs map to prod-bg-asg instances (i-0b11, i-0b22) and contribute negligibly. Top user 'api_service' confirms the load originates from the API tier, not background workers.
